The distance from the circle center \((a,1)\) to the line \(3x+4y=5\) must equal the radius \(4\):

\[
\frac{|3a+4(1)-5|}{\sqrt{3^2+4^2}} = 4
\]

\[
\frac{|3a-1|}{5}=4
\]

\[
|3a-1|=20
\]

So \(3a-1=20\) or \(3a-1=-20\), giving \(a=7\) or \(a=-\frac{19}{3}\). Since \(a>0\),

\[
\boxed{7}
\]
